tolerance.note: pass if |got-expected| <= max(abs, rel*|expected|); per-case 'tol' overrides; strings, booleans, nulls, regimes and error classes exact

convention: SI units: m, s, m^2/s, mol/m^3 (river mixing in mg/L as in the topic map). 1-D only, constant coefficients, at most 100 cells (101+ -> ConstraintViolation, reason too_many_cells). Flux positive from the left (high) boundary to the right. Membrane: J=D P (C_left-C_right)/L with dimensionless partition P. Gaussian pulse: C=M/sqrt(4 pi D t) exp(-(x-ut)^2/(4Dt)), M in mol/m^2. Lake: V dC/dt=Q(C_in-C)-kVC. Morphogen: D C''=kC, C(0)=C0, C->0, lambda=sqrt(D/k). Finite-volume cells of equal width dx, cell centres at (i+1/2)dx, mass=sum(C)dx. FTCS diffusion: C_i'=C_i+r(C_(i+1)-2C_i+C_(i-1)), r=D dt/dx^2; 'zero_flux' = no flux through the two end faces (mirror ghost cells); r<=0.5 accepted (compared with a relative slack of 1e-12), r>0.5 -> ConstraintViolation, reason ftcs_unstable_r_gt_0_5. First-order upwind (u>=0): C_i'=C_i-Co(C_i-C_(i-1)), Co=u dt/dx, cell -1 = inflow_concentration, 'zero_gradient_outflow' at the right end; Co<=1 accepted, Co>1 -> ConstraintViolation, reason upwind_unstable_courant_gt_1. A combined advection-diffusion step is NOT in these cases (needs its own bound). Errors (ruling 17:46: schema classes only, cause in expected.reason as lower_snake_case): MathError = mathematically undefined (dx_zero, thickness_zero, d_zero, dt_must_be_positive for dt=0); ConstraintViolation = input outside the allowed range or a stability/size limit checked before the run (d_must_be_non_negative, too_many_cells, ftcs_unstable_r_gt_0_5, upwind_unstable_courant_gt_1).
oracle: hand formulas re-checked independently in _build_fit_printers_tier1_kats.py: numpy finite-difference steady solves (membrane, scaffold), exact fractions (microchannel), scipy.stats.norm + quad mass check (Gaussian), numpy mass balance (river mix), solve_ivp DOP853 (lake, advection), solve_bvp (morphogen), own FTCS in matrix form and own upwind loop; x7-021 expected values are the exact discrete cosine-mode solution (1+lambda^n cos), not a simulation output

cases.desc: Two-film overall mass-transfer coefficient
cases.hand_check: 1/K=1/k1+1/k2=500+333.333=833.333; K=0.0012 m/s. Bird, Stewart and Lightfoot, Transport Phenomena, two-film (series resistance) theory. Oracle: series film resistances in a numpy linear flux balance.

cases.desc: Microchannel diffusion time and mixing length
cases.hand_check: t_D=L^2/D=1e-8/1e-9=10 s; L_mix=u t_D=0.2 m. Crank, The Mathematics of Diffusion, diffusion time scales. Oracle: L^2/D and u t_D in exact rational arithmetic (fractions).

cases.desc: Required Fick's-law membrane flux (D=1e-9, dC=100 over 1 mm)
cases.hand_check: J=D P (CL-CR)/L=1e-9(100)/0.001=1e-4 mol/(m^2 s) (must-reproduce). Crank, The Mathematics of Diffusion, steady diffusion through a plane sheet. Oracle: numpy steady finite-difference solve (50 nodes) of D C''=0, flux from the discrete gradient.

cases.desc: Partitioned membrane flux (P=0.5)
cases.hand_check: J=(2e-10)(0.5)(80)/5e-4=1.6e-5 mol/(m^2 s); partition applies to both faces. Crank, The Mathematics of Diffusion, membranes with partition coefficient. Oracle: FD solve with membrane-side boundary values P*CL, P*CR.

cases.desc: Linear steady scaffold profile: concentration at x and flux
cases.hand_check: C=100+(20-100)(0.0005/0.002)=80 mol/m^3; J=1e-9(80)/0.002=4e-5 mol/(m^2 s). Crank, The Mathematics of Diffusion. Oracle: FD solve, linear interpolation at x.

cases.desc: Required pure advection: tracer centre moves 100 m in 100 s at 1 m/s
cases.hand_check: x=x0+ut=100 m (must-reproduce). Chapra, Surface Water-Quality Modeling, advective transport. Oracle: solve_ivp of dx/dt=u.

cases.desc: Gaussian river pulse at its centre
cases.hand_check: C=M/sqrt(4 pi D t)=1/sqrt(200 pi)=0.0398942280 mol/m^3 at x=ut. Crank, The Mathematics of Diffusion, instantaneous plane source with advection. Oracle: scipy.stats.norm.pdf(x, ut, sqrt(2Dt)), and quad confirms the profile integrates to M.

cases.desc: Gaussian pulse at x-ut=sqrt(4Dt)
cases.hand_check: x-ut=sqrt(200): C=e^-1/sqrt(200 pi)=0.0146762663 mol/m^3. Input x given at full precision (draft truncated it to 39.1421356237). Crank, The Mathematics of Diffusion. Oracle: norm.pdf.

cases.desc: River Peclet number
cases.hand_check: Pe=uL/D=0.5(100)/2=25. Chapra, Surface Water-Quality Modeling, advection versus dispersion. Oracle: ratio of the advective and dispersive time scales (L^2/D)/(L/u).

cases.desc: Required river + effluent complete mixing: 3.636364 mg/L, not 4
cases.hand_check: C=(10(2)+1(20))/11=40/11=3.636364 mg/L (flow-weighted; the unweighted mean (2+20)/2=11 and the naive 4 are both wrong; must-reproduce). Units mg/L kept as in the map (1 mg/L = 1e-3 kg/m^3). Chapra, Surface Water-Quality Modeling, completely mixed systems. Oracle: numpy solve of the downstream mass balance Q_tot C = sum Q_i C_i and of the flow balance.

cases.desc: Well-mixed lake flushing with first-order decay
cases.hand_check: V dC/dt=Q(Cin-C)-kVC; tau=V/Q=100 s; C*=Cin(Q/V)/(Q/V+k)=10; C(t)=C*+(C0-C*)e^(-(Q/V+k)t)=10+40e^-2=15.413411 mol/m^3. Chapra, Surface Water-Quality Modeling, completely mixed lake. Oracle: solve_ivp of the ODE (rtol 1e-12).

cases.desc: Morphogen exponential gradient (synthesis at x=0, first-order decay)
cases.hand_check: D C''=kC, C(0)=C0, C->0: lambda=sqrt(D/k)=1e-3 m; C=10e^-2=1.3533528 mol/m^3. Crank, The Mathematics of Diffusion, diffusion with first-order reaction. Oracle: scipy solve_bvp on [0, 20 lambda].

cases.desc: FTCS one step at the exact stability limit r=0.5, zero-flux faces
cases.hand_check: r=D dt/dx^2=0.5 (accepted: bound is <=). C0'=0+0.5(10-0)=5; C1'=10+0.5(0-20+0)=0; C2'=5; mass sum(C)dx=10 before and after. LeVeque, Finite Difference Methods for Ordinary and Partial Differential Equations, FTCS stability r<=1/2. Oracle: own FTCS in matrix form (I + r A_Neumann).

cases.desc: FTCS just above the stability limit is rejected
cases.hand_check: r=0.500001>0.5: stability limit checked before the run -> ConstraintViolation, reason ftcs_unstable_r_gt_0_5 (ruling 17:46; not MathError: the update is computable). LeVeque, Finite Difference Methods for Ordinary and Partial Differential Equations. Oracle: stability check.

cases.desc: Zero grid spacing
cases.hand_check: r=D dt/dx^2 divides by 0 -> MathError, reason dx_zero. LeVeque, Finite Difference Methods for Ordinary and Partial Differential Equations. Oracle: zero-denominator test.

cases.desc: Negative diffusivity is physically invalid
cases.hand_check: D<0 violates D>=0 (second law); t_D=L^2/D would be computable but meaningless -> ConstraintViolation, reason d_must_be_non_negative. Crank, The Mathematics of Diffusion. Oracle: validation.

cases.desc: 101 cells exceeds the 100-cell scope cap
cases.hand_check: N=101>100 (X7 scope cap: 1-D, at most 100 cells), size limit checked before the run -> ConstraintViolation, reason too_many_cells. Oracle: length check.

cases.desc: First-order upwind at Courant number exactly 1 shifts one cell
cases.hand_check: Co=u dt/dx=1: C_i'=C_i-Co(C_i-C_(i-1))=C_(i-1); inflow 0 enters cell 0. LeVeque, Finite Difference Methods for Ordinary and Partial Differential Equations, upwind method and CFL condition. Oracle: own upwind loop.

cases.desc: Zero-thickness membrane
cases.hand_check: J=DP(CL-CR)/L divides by L=0 -> MathError, reason thickness_zero. Crank, The Mathematics of Diffusion. Oracle: zero-denominator test.

cases.desc: Zero diffusivity in the microchannel time scale
cases.hand_check: t_D=L^2/D divides by D=0 -> MathError, reason d_zero (D=0 is physically allowed elsewhere, e.g. pure advection, but this quantity is undefined). Crank, The Mathematics of Diffusion. Oracle: zero-denominator test.

cases.desc: FTCS 400 steps, 100 cells (cap), zero-flux: exact discrete cosine-mode decay and mass conservation
cases.hand_check: r=1e-9(0.025)/1e-10=0.25. cos(pi(i+1/2)/N) is an exact eigenvector of the zero-flux FTCS operator (mirror ghost cells) with factor lambda=1-4r sin^2(pi/2N)=0.99975328; after n steps C_i=1+lambda^n cos(pi(i+1/2)/N). Mass sum(C)dx=N dx=1e-3 (cosine sums to 0) is conserved exactly (must-reproduce: bound + conservation). LeVeque, Finite Difference Methods for Ordinary and Partial Differential Equations, von Neumann analysis; Crank, The Mathematics of Diffusion. Oracle: own FTCS stepped 400 times in matrix form.

cases.desc: Upwind at Co=0.5 stays bounded (one step)
cases.hand_check: C1'=10-0.5(10-0)=5; C2'=0-0.5(0-10)=5; C0'=0; values stay within [0,10] (monotone for 0<=Co<=1). LeVeque, Finite Difference Methods for Ordinary and Partial Differential Equations. Oracle: own upwind loop.

cases.desc: Upwind at Co=1.5 is rejected
cases.hand_check: Co=1.5>1 violates the CFL condition for first-order upwind -> ConstraintViolation, reason upwind_unstable_courant_gt_1. LeVeque, Finite Difference Methods for Ordinary and Partial Differential Equations. Oracle: stability check.

cases.desc: Upwind run, Co=1, 100 cells: centre moves 100 m in 100 s (numerical must-reproduce)
cases.hand_check: Co=1 shifts exactly one cell (2 m) per 2 s step: after 50 steps (100 s) the pulse sits in cell 50, centre (50+1/2)2=101 m, displaced 100 m = u t; mass 10(2)=20 kept (nothing has left the 200 m domain). LeVeque, Finite Difference Methods for Ordinary and Partial Differential Equations; Chapra, Surface Water-Quality Modeling. Oracle: own upwind loop, centre of mass sum(x C)/sum(C).
